verdict.rationale: Zamzar's own site documents browser-based conversion with nothing to install: pick a file, choose a target format and convert, with sources including local files, URLs and cloud drives. Conversion runs on Zamzar's cloud servers, not locally, but the story only requires a browser and no installed software. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the browser flow, and in-depth documentation beyond marketing copy.

support.subject: As a power user, a one-off conversion works in the browser with nothing installed

citations.quote: No software to download. Just select your file, pick a format to convert to and away you go.
you can upload files in your web browser without any technical knowledge needed. Just pick your files, choose the format to convert to and we'll do the rest for you.
